course.title: GullHaven Links
course.welcome: Welcome to GullHaven Links! Eighteen holes round the bay, seven of them on the cliffs. The greens are small and the sea is everywhere.

npcs.name: Lodge chest
npcs.examine: The Lodge chest, oak with brass corners. Everything you own from Ashvale is kept in your arcade wallet; this is where you see it.

npcs.name: Moira the starter
npcs.examine: The starter at the bay links. She keeps the tee sheet.
